$comment: Curated answers for the site assistant. These are the primary match target:
the visitor's question is compared against the `questions` array, and
question-to-question similarity scores far higher than question-to-marketing-copy.
Every `questions` entry becomes its own vector pointing at the same answer, so
adding paraphrases is the cheapest way to widen coverage.
`answer` is shown verbatim. Write it as a reply a person would give, keep it
under about 70 words, and never claim something the public site does not.
`followUps` are ids of other entries, offered as one-tap chips.
Passages extracted from the live site and Document Center are indexed too and
cover the long tail. Curated entries exist for questions that deserve a
deliberate answer rather than whatever paragraph happens to rank.

questions: How does the Greyquill Method work?
How do you actually run an engagement?
entries.answer: Three sequenced phases, each run by one layer of the platform. Foundation gives every model a record it can stand on, using GQData. Govern turns your rules into controls the system can prove it followed, using GQ Govern. Activate ships the use case with oversight that scales, using GQ Agents. Each phase targets a specific place AI projects die.

questions: Why do most AI projects fail?
Why do only 5 in 100 GenAI ideas reach production?
What goes wrong with enterprise AI?
entries.answer: Of every 100 GenAI ideas started, roughly 5 reach production. About 40 are lost because the data was never AI-ready, 35 fall over at evaluation when nobody can evidence that controls held, and 20 die in production without oversight. The Method maps one phase onto each of those three failures.

questions: Tell me about your data product
How do you make data AI-ready?
entries.answer: GQData is the trusted-data layer beneath every AI decision. It unifies master data into golden records, repairs quality at source rather than downstream, stamps active lineage on what your models consume, and classifies sensitivity. It is the Foundation tier that GQ Govern and GQ Agents both build on.

questions: How do you handle AI governance?
entries.answer: GQ Govern turns a written policy into something the system can produce evidence for. Controls are checked against frameworks including the EU AI Act, GDPR, and SOC 2, and each control is tied to the policy that enforces it. Exceptions carry an expiry rather than becoming a permanent bypass.

questions: How do you run agents safely in production?
entries.answer: GQ Agents is the Activate tier: productionised generative and agentic workloads with oversight that scales. Evidence is assembled while the agent runs rather than reconstructed afterwards, so provenance, checkpoints, and an audit trail exist by the time anyone asks for them.

questions: Do you work in regulated industries?
Do you work in banking or financial services?
Have you shipped in telecom or retail?
entries.answer: Yes, that is the whole focus. We have shipped governed AI in production across BFSI, telecom, and retail, and have delivered in healthcare and public sector work where the governance bar is just as high. The platform exists because regulated enterprises need AI they can put in front of an auditor.

questions: Does my data leave my environment?
Do we have to move our data to you?
What about data residency and sovereignty?
entries.answer: Your data stays where it is. The platform installs into your own environment, meaning your cloud account, your region, and your identity provider, and reads data in place. There is no requirement to ship raw copies to us.

questions: How do I book a call?
What does your discovery process look like?
entries.answer: Start with a 30-minute discovery call. Bring your hardest data or policy question and we will tell you honestly whether the bottleneck is data, process, or model. Fuller discovery adds stakeholder interviews, a working session with the team that owns the problem, and a business and technical analysis. We do not write code until everyone agrees on what we are building.

questions: I need to be Greyquill certified
Is there a Greyquill certification programme?
Do you run training for our team?
entries.answer: We do not run a Greyquill certification programme. We do run training as part of consulting engagements, including workshops and enablement so your team can operate what we build once we hand it over. If you have something specific in mind, a short call is the fastest way to scope it.

questions: How do I become a partner?
Do you have a partner programme?
I want to work with Greyquill
entries.answer: We work with technology and delivery partners, and the partnerships page sets out who we already build alongside. There is no self-serve partner programme to sign up to, so the route is a direct conversation about what you have in mind.

questions: How do I get in touch?
How do I reach the team?
entries.answer: Email us at hello@greyquill.io or send a note through the contact page, and if you would rather talk it through, a 30-minute discovery call is easy to book.

questions: Do you have a phone number?
I need to speak to someone
Is there a number I can call?
This is urgent, how do I reach you quickly?
entries.answer: You can call us on +91 80505 22809, though email at hello@greyquill.io or a booked 30-minute discovery call usually gets you a fuller answer.

questions: What other products do you have?
Show me your full product range
What is in the Greyquill platform?
entries.answer: Four platform layers, and four things built on them. GQData is the trusted-data layer beneath every AI decision. GQ Govern is the policy layer that makes AI defensible. GQ Agents handles multi-agent orchestration with audit trails built in. GQ Studio is one application shell for the whole platform. Three vertical products sit on top: GST Co-Pilot for GST reconciliation, Commerce Synapse for retail and commerce operations, and Umami for clinical practice management. ClarityAI stands alone, scoring the clarity and risk of an initiative before you fund it.
